content: Long-lived SSE/EventSource clients leak memory via orphaned interval/watchdog timers and listeners that survive reconnects if not explicitly cleared before reconnecting. Reconnect storms after outages amplify downstream load (e.g. 2x subscribe ops) unless backoff includes jitter, not just exponential delay. On the write side (res.write to slow consumers), ignoring the false return value and not pausing on backpressure accumulates unbounded kernel buffers until the socket is forcibly killed.
